deadline.value: General Fall priority admission and merit-based funding deadline is January 15 (applied automatically with the admission application); general international Fall deadline is May 15.
deadline.quote: Priority Admission Application Deadline / Priority Funding Deadline (applies only to Fall semester admissions): January 15 | International Student Admission Application Deadline: May 15

gre_general.value: Satisfactory GRE scores are required for unconditional admission to the Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. program.
gre_general.quote: To be considered for unconditional admission to the Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, an applicant must have the Master of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field with a minimum GPA of 3.3 and satisfactory GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Mechanical Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No pre-admission supervisor commitment is required; graduate students select an academic advisor during their first semester and a dissertation advisor by 27 attempted credit hours.
supervisor.quote: All graduate students must select an academic advisor during their first semester of enrollment and an advisory committee by the end of the first year.

funding.value: Engineering Ph.D. students compete for College of Engineering GRAs/GTAs and Graduate College Doctoral GTAs ($20,000 minimum 9-month stipend plus tuition and health insurance).
funding.quote: Graduate Research Assistantships (GRAs) are available to M.S. and Ph.D. students. ... Availability of GRAs is dependent on faculty research areas and funding/grant status. | Academic background and familiarity with course content will play a role in selection for GTA positions.

also.quote: However, currently only a portion of qualified students will be supported as GTAs.

entry_route.value: Direct admission is open to B.S.M.E. graduates from an accredited program with a 3.5+ GPA, as well as M.S. graduates in ME or a closely related field with a 3.3+ GPA.
entry_route.quote: A student with a BSME degree from an accredited program with a 3.5 GPA or higher, satisfactory GRE scores, and strong reference letters may be admitted directly to the PhD program.

notes: Focus areas include Aerospace, Materials, Control & System Dynamics, Fluids & Thermal Management, and Mechatronics & Machine Design.
